speaker: BEOR
text: Listen before you pull. The river is already telling you where it wants to go.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: Hold this end. There. Now you have a job.

speaker: GIRL_CHILD
text: If I let go, will we float away?

speaker: BEOR
text: She trusts you now. Bring her back with all her fingers.

speaker: BEOR
text: Tomorrow you can take the late crossing. Let that hand rest.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: You said that yesterday. I saw you rubbing your shoulder when you thought I was asleep.

speaker: BEOR
text: Then tomorrow we shall both pretend to be strong. Put out the lamp when you're done.

speaker: GOD
text: Balaam.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: Father? Did you need water?

speaker: GOD
text: Balaam, son of Beor. Take your lamp to the old landing.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: Who is there? I can't see you.

speaker: GOD
text: A family's steering oar will break below the bend before dawn. Hang your lamp high. Give them somewhere to steer.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: This landing has been empty for years. Will they even see it?

speaker: GOD
text: Stay here.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Hold the sack with your foot. Keep your hands inside the boat.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: Look up! Beneath the light! There's quiet water under these steps!

speaker: MOTHER
text: I see it. Keep still, little one. I can see where we're going.

speaker: GIRL_CHILD
text: You left the light for us?

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: Someone called me.

speaker: MOTHER
text: When you learn who it was, tell Him we made it home.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: Who called me? I came back. I wanted to know if You would speak again.

speaker: GOD
text: Come again tomorrow.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: I told Father I would be quick. That was before I started talking.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: The man at the ferry paid us twice. I took it back. He thought I wanted more.

speaker: BEOR
text: Did you get your answer, or did you go there just to get wet?

speaker: GOD
text: Take food to the house with the broken stool. Stay long enough to eat with him.

speaker: NEIGHBOR
text: If you've come about my son, nobody has brought word.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: I came to eat. But I can hold that steady while you mend it.

speaker: NEIGHBOR
text: Come back tomorrow. I think I have enough grain for two.

speaker: GOD
text: Keep this lane empty until evening. Set the jars across it.

speaker: HADAN
text: Are we selling the road now? What does a man pay to walk through?

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: Walk around today. I was told to leave this stretch clear until evening.

speaker: BAKER
text: You two can argue over the crumbs where I can see you.

speaker: HADAN
text: You could at least tell me what we are waiting for.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: I don't know yet.

speaker: BOY1
text: We didn't break it. We were over here.

speaker: HADAN
text: Take it. We would have been standing there. Someone ought to give you something.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: She has lost her board. Buy her timber. She still has to work tomorrow.

speaker: HADAN
text: Next time, tell me which jars to carry. I made you do all the lifting.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: The little one thought he had broken the wall.

speaker: GOD
text: Go home. Your father is saving supper.

speaker: BEOR
text: People have started asking when you will speak. You are still allowed to eat first.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: I didn't go up to ask anything tonight. I just wanted to be there.

speaker: GOD
text: Bring dry clothes. Lay them above the wet line.

speaker: WOMAN
text: This was for my brother. Who are we waiting for?

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: I haven't been given a name. Help me keep these out of the spray.

speaker: WOMAN
text: That's him. That's my brother!

speaker: BROTHER
text: The ferry broke loose. We thought the bend would carry us past everyone.

speaker: TRAPPED_WOMAN
text: Tell my son I'm still here.

speaker: SON
text: She went to her sister. We looked here already.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: She said, tell my son I'm still here. Call to her once more.

speaker: SON
text: Mother? It's me. Stay where you are. We can hear you.

speaker: BEOR
text: Take it with you if you mean to make it cold again.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: I'll be back before you finish that piece.

speaker: GOD
text: Take off your sandals. Keep your lamp.

speaker: GOD
text: A child is under a stair. His mother is looking for him.

speaker: CITY_MOTHER
text: Has anyone seen my son? He went back into the yard!

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: Where is the stair? Show me the stair outside the workshop.

speaker: BOY1
text: I couldn't leave him. I thought you would be angry.

speaker: CITY_MOTHER
text: Hold my sleeve. Both of you. Keep coming.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: What city is this? I don't know these streets.

speaker: CITY_MOTHER
text: Where did you come from? There are six days of road between here and Pethor.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: Someone heard you calling.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: Where do You want me to go now?

speaker: BEOR
text: You have been gone less than a meal. Where did that ash come from?

speaker: TRADER
text: A woman sent me looking for a man with a river lamp.

speaker: TRADER
text: She asked everyone. Someone heard your name here. Her boy wanted you to have this.

speaker: BALAAM_Y
text: He made it too small to carry anyone through a fire. But I think he tried.

speaker: GIRL_ADULT
text: They came before sunrise. I told them you still have to wake up.

speaker: NEIGHBOR
text: He went out after the goats. The goats came back without him.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Then we start where the goats came down. Take me there.

speaker: TRADER
text: I have waited three days. Tell me which road to take.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I have no word for you today. I can share what I know of the roads.

speaker: TRADER
text: People said you always had an answer. Have I brought too little?

speaker: BEOR
text: He has to eat while he waits too. Sit with him if you like.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Who is waiting for you when the caravan gets home?

speaker: GOD
text: By evening the water will reach this basket. Clear the upper path.

speaker: HADAN
text: There hasn't been rain here for weeks. How far up are you asking us to move?

speaker: MOTHER
text: I remember a lamp nobody thought we needed. Bring the children up first.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Leave the sacks for now. Make room on the path for the little ones.

speaker: GIRL_ADULT
text: One at a time. There is room for everyone above the turn.

speaker: BEOR
text: You could have told me how many goats were involved.

speaker: MOTHER
text: You told us early enough to make a road. We will remember that.

speaker: BEOR
text: It's the cold. Leave the bowl. I can manage it.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: You are burning. How long have you felt like this?

speaker: BEOR
text: Since yesterday. I thought it would pass before you noticed.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Father is ill. You know him. Tell me what I should do.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I can stay. I'll wait here if that's what You want.

speaker: BEOR
text: Open the door a little. I can't hear the river.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: It's there. The river is still there. I'm staying with you.

speaker: HEALER
text: Keep water near him. There is a man farther down the road who may know more.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: How far? Tell me the road and where to find him.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: You took me to a child six days away. Take me to someone who can help him.

speaker: GOD
text: I have heard you. Help will come. Stay with your father tonight.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Will he live? Please. I need to know what You are asking me to wait for.

speaker: HADAN
text: I heard about your father. I can send for the other healer now.

speaker: HADAN
text: Those families owe grain. The meadow settles it. The elders will listen if you tell them God has answered.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: God has told me nothing about your meadow. Take your silver and go.

speaker: HADAN
text: I'll be at the boundary stone tomorrow. You know how long that road is.

speaker: BEOR
text: You don't have to keep waking me to see if I'm here.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I don't know how to do this. I keep listening for the next breath.

speaker: BEOR
text: Sit a little closer. You can hear it from here.

speaker: WOMAN
text: Where do you want our animals when the upper grass is gone?

speaker: BAKER
text: Did God tell you Hadan should have the meadow?

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: He did.

speaker: BOY2
text: Why can't she eat there? She always eats there.

speaker: DRIVER
text: He left before I arrived. They couldn't tell me when he would come back.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I thought I could make it happen sooner.

speaker: ADVERSARY
text: At dawn Hadan will knock twice. He will bring back the unused silver.
delivery: same calm timbre as divine voice

speaker: ADVERSARY
text: The piece on top has a nick in it. Keep it. You can send for someone else.

speaker: HADAN
text: The driver brought back what he couldn't spend. I said I would bring it myself.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Then I heard You. I did hear You.

speaker: BOY2
text: Can you ask Him to let us back in?

speaker: WOMAN
text: Come. We have farther to walk today.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: God never spoke about the meadow. Hadan offered help for my father. I told you a lie.

speaker: HADAN
text: You asked the cart to leave. You stood here and gave the answer yourself.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I did. I knew I had no word. Open the gate. The silver is all here.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I knew what I was doing. I used Your name because I was afraid. Forgive me.

speaker: GOD
text: I forgive you. Go home.

speaker: MOTHER
text: Sit down. We have him. You look as though you haven't slept.

speaker: GIRL_ADULT
text: He was traveling with relatives in the next settlement. I asked him to come with me.

speaker: HEALER
text: I will return in the morning. Let someone else sit with him tonight.

speaker: BEOR
text: Did you open the door? I can hear the river.

speaker: BEOR
text: He's tied it too low. When the water rises, he'll learn why I kept shouting.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Then you can shout tomorrow. He has all afternoon to get it wrong.

speaker: FIELD_MAN
text: My father drew the boundary badly. My sister has more than she should. They will hear you.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Your father's agreement gave her that ground. I have heard no word changing it.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I can put it right tomorrow. He forgave me before.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I came to ask... I knew I would come here before I took it.

speaker: GOD
text: Go to her house.

speaker: FIELD_SISTER
text: You have come to look at the ground you gave away?

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Your brother paid me. I knew your father's agreement. I will tell the elders the truth.

speaker: FIELD_SISTER
text: Who will bring the animals back? Your words sent them half a day's walk away.

speaker: FIELD_SISTER
text: Leave the gate unlatched when you go. I still have another trip to make.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: The handle should hold now. I tested it at the well.

speaker: TRADER
text: A blessing before witnesses. The buyer need hear nothing about the lower field.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Then tell him about the lower field. I won't speak over a bargain you are hiding.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Take the upper road. The crossing below the tamarisks has gone.

speaker: BEOR
text: The neighbors have done a fine job. You can stop checking it every time it rains.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: He dropped the onions overboard and blamed the rope. I held the other end. He knew I knew.

speaker: FIELD_SISTER
text: Come in before it gets cold. I made enough.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I haven't heard anything about that. Sit down and tell me what happened.

speaker: TRADER
text: The barefoot man with the lamp lives here. Ask the families who brought him home to supper.

speaker: ISRAEL_BROTHER
text: Hit the ground beside it first. You keep bruising the rope.

speaker: ISRAEL_YOUNG
text: Both hands. You can stop halfway. Nobody is counting your steps.

speaker: BALAK
text: Who can speak against a people like this and be heard?

speaker: ENVOY
text: There is a man in Pethor. People who have never seen his village know his name.

speaker: BALAK
text: Have you met someone who saw him? I have heard enough travelers' stories.

speaker: ENVOY
text: A mother in a burning city. He appeared barefoot with a lamp. Her child was beneath a stair.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: You have come far. Eat first. Then tell me why you are here.

speaker: ENVOY
text: Balak asks you to come. Curse this people for him, so he may drive them away.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Stay tonight. I will bring you the answer God gives me.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Men from Balak. They want me to curse the people who came out of Egypt.

speaker: GOD
text: Do not go with them. Do not curse the people. They are blessed.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Then I will send them home in the morning.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: God has refused me permission to go. You must return without me.

speaker: ENVOY
text: He would not come with us.

speaker: BALAK
text: Send men of greater standing. Tell him I will honor him greatly.

speaker: ENVOY
text: Let nothing keep you from the king. Name what you require.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Even a house full of silver and gold would give me no right to go beyond God's word.

speaker: ADVERSARY
text: You already know you will not curse them. Go and hear what the king offers.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I would only listen. I can keep the word I have given.

speaker: GOD
text: If the men have come to call you, go with them. Do only what I tell you.

speaker: ADVERSARY
text: You can speak what God gives you and still come home with honor.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Come on. They are already ahead of us.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: What are you doing? Back to the road.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: You crushed my foot. Move away from the wall!

speaker: SERVANT1
text: Master, let me look at the strap.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Get up. Get up now.

speaker: DONKEY_VOICE
text: What have I done to you, that you have struck me three times?
delivery: clear ordinary speech, no comic voice

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: You have made a fool of me. If I had a sword, I would kill you.

speaker: DONKEY_VOICE
text: Am I not your donkey? Have I ever treated you this way before?

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: No.

speaker: ANGEL
text: Why have you struck your donkey? She saw me and turned aside. She has saved your life.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I have sinned. I did not know you stood against me. If it displeases you, I will turn back.

speaker: ANGEL
text: Go with the men. Speak only the word I tell you.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I should have listened to you.

speaker: ADVERSARY
text: Say what God tells you. The king can still pay you.

speaker: BALAK
text: Did I not send for you? Did you think I could not honor you?

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I have come. I can speak only the word God puts in my mouth.

speaker: ENVOY
text: Tomorrow the king will show you what troubles him.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Prepare the altars here. I will go aside and see what God will show me.

speaker: GOD
text: Return to Balak. Speak the word I give you.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: How shall I curse those whom God has not cursed? How shall I denounce those He has not denounced?

speaker: BALAK
text: I brought you to curse my enemies. You have blessed them.

speaker: BALAK
text: Come here. You will see only part of them. Perhaps you can speak from here.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: He has blessed them. I have received a blessing, and I cannot reverse it.

speaker: BALAK
text: Then say nothing. Neither curse them nor bless them.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Did I not tell you I must speak what God gives me?

speaker: ISRAEL_BROTHER
text: That will hold. Put it where we can find it tomorrow.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: The word of the man whose eyes are opened, who hears God's words and sees the vision of the Almighty.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: How lovely are your tents, Jacob. Like gardens beside a river, spread out beneath His care.

speaker: BALAK
text: Three times you have blessed them. Go home. Your God has kept you from honor.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Your men heard what I said before I came. Your silver could never buy another word.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I see him, though the time is distant. A star will come from Jacob. A scepter will rise from Israel.

speaker: ENVOY
text: Can that people be touched at all?

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: You heard the blessing.

speaker: ENVOY
text: What if they bring trouble on themselves?

speaker: ADVERSARY
text: You could not draw the blessing away from them. They can walk away from it themselves.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: I was told what to speak. I have spoken it.

speaker: ADVERSARY
text: A guest can be welcomed to a table. He chooses whether to bow with the people who feed him.
delivery: calm accurate observation made into bait

speaker: ENVOY
text: You have thought of something.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Invite the men to the feasts. Give them food and company. Let the women welcome them.

speaker: ENVOY
text: And when the feast becomes worship?

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Some will bow with their hosts. Let their own choices carry them where a curse could not.

speaker: ISRAEL_BROTHER
text: If you go, be back before the lamps burn low. We move the animals in the morning.

speaker: HOST_WOMAN
text: There is more than we can eat. Come while it is warm. Your friends can come too.

speaker: ISRAEL_YOUNG
text: I will be back before you finish mending that strap.

speaker: HOST_WOMAN
text: You looked as though you would leave before you even sat down.

speaker: ISRAEL_YOUNG
text: My brother expects every road to take twice as long when I walk it.

speaker: HOST_WOMAN
text: Come with us. We give thanks before the next offering.

speaker: ISRAEL_BROTHER
text: You said one evening. You have gone back three times. What are you doing there?

speaker: ISRAEL_YOUNG
text: They feed us. They welcome us. Must everything become an argument?

speaker: TRADER
text: There is sickness in the camp. People are dying. They speak of what happened at Peor.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: How many?

speaker: TRADER
text: I don't know. Did you have someone among them?

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: No. I saw their tents from the mountain.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Lord...
delivery: one word followed by sustained silence

speaker: MOSES
text: Stay with your households. Bring word of those who need water and care.
delivery: original connective dialogue, grief held steady

speaker: MOSES
text: Remember what led us here. Remember the names of those we lost.

speaker: MIDIAN_MAN
text: You can stay here while the roads are watched. There is room beside the eastern tents.

speaker: MIDIAN_MAN
text: The fighting has passed the outer shelters. Take what you can carry and go.

speaker: BALAAM_A
text: Which road is still open?

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Why is that post so high? You couldn't tie a boat up there.

speaker: GIRL_OLDER
text: A man hung a lamp there for us once. We could see it from the bend.

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Did he know you?

speaker: GIRL_OLDER
text: No. He came out to wait for us.

speaker: GIRL_OLDER
text: We came around there. My mother saw the light and knew where to steer.

speaker: GOD
text: Come again tomorrow.
